items.subtype: subject-verb agreement across an intervening of-phrase
secondary_features: subject-verb agreement across an intervening prepositional phrase
items.sentence: The retreat of the continental ice sheets that once covered northern Europe have left behind thick deposits of gravel and clay.
items.error_explanation: The head of the subject noun phrase is the singular noun 'retreat'; the of-phrase 'of the continental ice sheets' and the relative clause 'that once covered northern Europe' only modify it and cannot supply the subject. A singular head requires the singular auxiliary 'has', so the plural 'have' is an agreement failure produced by attraction to the nearer plural noun. The relative clause already contains its own finite verb 'covered', so 'have left' cannot be construed inside it. 'that' correctly introduces a restrictive relative clause whose antecedent is 'ice sheets', 'thick' is an adjective correctly modifying 'deposits', and 'gravel' is a mass noun correctly used after 'deposits of'.
